verses.geez:
ዝውእቱ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እለ ፡ ቦኡ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡
                  [ለ]ለአሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ በበ ፡ አዕጻዲሆሙ ፡ ቦኡ ።
verses.translation: These are the names of the sons of Israel that came into Egypt together with Jacob their father; they came in each with their whole family.

translations.lxx: These are the names of the sons of Israel that came into Egypt together with Jacob their father; they came in each with their whole family.
translations.kjv: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
translations.ron: Numele fiilor lui Israel, care au intrat în Egipt împreună cu Iacov, tatăl lor, aducând fiecare toată casa sa, sunt acestea:
translations.grk: ΤΑΥΤΑ τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ τῶν εἰσπεπορευμένων εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἅμα Ἰακὼβ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτῶν, ἕκαστος πανοικὶ αὐτῶν εἰσήλθοσαν.

verses.geez: ሮቤል ፡ ወስምዖን ፡ ወሌዊ ፡ ወይሁዳ ።
verses.translation: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Judas,

translations.lxx: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Judas,
translations.kjv: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
translations.ron: Ruben, Simeon, Levi şi Iuda;
translations.grk: Ῥουβὴν, Συμεών, Λευὶ, Ἰούδας,

verses.geez: ወይ[ሳኮ]ር ፡ ወዛቡሎን ፡ ወብንያም ።
verses.translation: Issachar, Zabulon, Benjamin,

translations.lxx: Issachar, Zabulon, Benjamin,
translations.kjv: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
translations.ron: Isahar, Zabulon şi Veniamin;
translations.grk: Ἰσσάχαρ, Ζαβουλὼν, Βενιαμὶν,

verses.geez: ወዳን ፡ ወንፍታሌም ፡ ወጋድ ፡ ወአሴር ።
verses.translation: Dan and Nephthalim, Gad and Aser.

translations.lxx: Dan and Nephthalim, Gad and Aser.
translations.kjv: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
translations.ron: Dan, Neftali, Gad şi Aşer.
translations.grk: Δὰν, καὶ Νεφθαλὶ, Γὰδ, καὶ Ἀσήρ.

verses.geez: ወዮሴፍሰ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወኮነት ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ እንተ ፡ እምያዕቆብ ፡ ፸፭ ።
verses.translation: But Joseph was in Egypt. And all the souls born of Jacob were seventy-five.

translations.lxx: But Joseph was in Egypt. And all the souls born of Jacob were seventy-five.
translations.kjv: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
translations.ron: Sufletele însă ieşite din Iacov erau de toate şaptezeci şi cinci, iar Iosif era de mai înainte în Egipt.
translations.grk: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ἦν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ· ἦσαν δὲ πᾶσαι ψυχαὶ ἐξ Ἰακὼβ, πέντε καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ አኀዊሁ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.translation: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

translations.lxx: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
translations.kjv: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
translations.ron: Dar au murit şi Iosif şi toţi fraţii lui şi toţi cei de pe vremea lor.
translations.grk: Ἐτελεύτησε δὲ Ἰωσὴφ, καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ πᾶσα ἡ γενεὰ ἐκείνη.

verses.geez: ወበዝኁ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወመልኡ ፡ ወኮኑ ፡ ሕቁራነ ፡ ወጸንዑ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ዕዙዘ ፡ ወመልአት ፡ ምድር ፡ እምኖሙ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel increased and multiplied, and became numerous and grew exceedingly strong, and the land multiplied them.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel increased and multiplied, and became numerous and grew exceedingly strong, and the land multiplied them.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Israel s-au născut în număr mare şi s-au înmulţit, au crescut şi s-au întărit foarte, foarte tare, şi s-a umplut ţara de ei.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ηὐξήθησαν, καὶ ἐπληθύνθησαν, καὶ χυδαῖοι ἐγένοντο, καὶ κατίσχυον σφόδρα σφόδρα· ἐπλήθυνε δὲ ἡ γῆ αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወተንሥአ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ካልእ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ዘአያአምሮ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ።
verses.translation: And there arose up another king over Egypt, who knew not Joseph.

translations.lxx: And there arose up another king over Egypt, who knew not Joseph.
translations.kjv: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
translations.ron: Dar s-a ridicat alt rege peste Egipt, care nu cunoscuse pe Iosif.
translations.grk: Ἀνέστη δὲ βασιλεὺς ἕτερος ἐπʼ Αἴγυπτον, ὃς οὐκ ᾔδει τὸν Ἰωσήφ.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ወብዙኅ ፡ ወይጸንዑነ ።
verses.translation: And he said to his nation, Behold, the race of the children of Israel is a great multitude, and is stronger than we:

translations.lxx: And he said to his nation, Behold, the race of the children of Israel is a great multitude, and is stronger than we:
translations.kjv: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
translations.ron: Acesta a zis către poporul său: "Iată, neamul fiilor lui Israel e mulţime mare şi e mai tare decât noi.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ τῷ ἔθνει αὐτοῦ, ἰδοὺ τὸ γένος τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ μέγα πλῆθος, καὶ ἰσχύει ὑπὲρ ἡμᾶς.

verses.geez:
ንዑ ፡ ንጠበቦሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ እምከመ ፡ በዝኁ ፡ ወቦከመ ፡ በጽሐነ ፡ ፀብእ ፡ ይትዌሰኩ ፡ እሉኒ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ፀርነ ፡
                  ወይፀብኡነ ፡ ወይወፅኡ ፡ እምድርነ ።
verses.translation: come then, let us deal craftily with them, lest at any time they be increased, and whensoever war shall happen to us, these also shall be added to our enemies, and having prevailed against us in war, they will depart out of the land.

translations.lxx: come then, let us deal craftily with them, lest at any time they be increased, and whensoever war shall happen to us, these also shall be added to our enemies, and having prevailed against us in war, they will depart out of the land.
translations.kjv: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
translations.ron: Veniţi dar să-i împilăm, ca să nu se mai înmulţească şi ca nu cumva la vreme de război să se unească cu vrăjmaşii noştri şi, bătându-ne, să iasă din ţara noastră!"
translations.grk: Δεῦτε οὖν κατασοφισώμεθα αὐτοὺς, μήποτε πληθυνθῇ, καὶ ἡνίκα ἂν συμβῇ ἡμῖν πόλεμος, προστεθήσονται καὶ οὗτοι πρὸς τοὺς ὑπεναντίους, καὶ ἐκπολεμήσαντες ἡμᾶς, ἐξελεύσονται ἐκ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ወሤመ ፡ ዲቤሆሙ ፡ ሊቃነ ፡ ገባር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሣቅይዎሙ ፡ በግብር ፤ ወነደቁ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ጽኑዓተ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ፈቶ[ም
                  ፡] ወራምሴ ፡ ወኦን ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ፀሐይ ።
verses.translation: And he set over them task-masters, who should afflict them in their works; and they built strong cities for Pharao, both Pitho, and Ramesses, and On, which is Heliopolis.

translations.lxx: And he set over them task-masters, who should afflict them in their works; and they built strong cities for Pharao, both Pitho, and Ramesses, and On, which is Heliopolis.
translations.kjv: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
translations.ron: De aceea au pus peste ei supraveghetori de lucrări, ca să-i împileze cu munci grele. Atunci a zidit Israel cetăţi tari lui Faraon: Pitom şi Ramses, care serveau lui Faraon ca hambare, şi cetatea On sau Iliopolis.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπέστησεν αὐτοῖς ἐπιστάτας τῶν ἔργων, ἵνα κακώσωσιν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις. Καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν πόλεις ὀχυρὰς τῷ Φαραῷ, τήν τε Πειθὼ, καὶ Ῥαμεσσῆ, καὶ Ὢν, ἥ ἐστιν Ἡλιού πολις.

verses.geez: ወበአምጣነ ፡ ይሣቅይዎሙ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይበዝኁ ፡ ወይጸንዑ ፡ ወያስቆርርዎሙ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: But as they humbled them, by so much they multiplied, and grew exceedingly strong; and the Egyptians greatly abhorred the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: But as they humbled them, by so much they multiplied, and grew exceedingly strong; and the Egyptians greatly abhorred the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Însă cu cât îi împilau mai mult, cu atât mai mult se înmulţeau şi se întăreau foarte, foarte tare, aşa că Egiptenii se îngrozeau de fiii lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καθότι δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐταπείνουν, τοσούτῳ πλείους ἐγίνοντο, καὶ ἴσχυον σφόδρα σφόδρα· καὶ ἐβδελύσσοντο οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ወይትኤገልዎሙ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በሥቃይ ።
verses.translation: And the Egyptians tyrannised over the children of Israel by force.

translations.lxx: And the Egyptians tyrannised over the children of Israel by force.
translations.kjv: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
translations.ron: De aceea Egiptenii sileau încă şi mai straşnic la muncă pe fiii lui Israel
translations.grk: Καὶ κατεδυνάστευον οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ βίᾳ.

verses.geez:
ወያጼዕሩ ፡ ሕይወተ ፡ ነፍሶሙ ፡ በግብር ፡ ዕፁብ ፡ በፅቡር ፡ ወበግንፋል ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ሐቅል ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡
                  ግብር ፡ ዘይቀንይዎሙ ፡ በሥቃይ ።
verses.translation: And they embittered their life by hard labours, in the clay and in brick-making, and all the works in the plains, according to all the works, wherein they caused them to serve with violence.

translations.lxx: And they embittered their life by hard labours, in the clay and in brick-making, and all the works in the plains, according to all the works, wherein they caused them to serve with violence.
translations.kjv: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
translations.ron: Şi le făceau viaţa amară prin munci grele, la lut, la cărămidă şi la tot felul de lucru de câmp şi prin alte felurite munci, la care-i sileau cu străşnicie.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατωδύνων αὐτῶν τὴν ζωὴν ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς σκληροῖς, τῷ πηλῷ καὶ τῇ πλινθείᾳ, καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις, κατὰ πάντα τὰ ἔργα, ὧν κατεδουλοῦντο αὐτοὺς μετὰ βίας.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ለመወልዳተ ፡ ዕብራይ ፡ ስማ ፡ ለአሐቲ ፡ ስፓ[ራ] ፡ ወስመ ፡ ካልእታ ፡ ፎሓ ።
verses.translation: And the king of the Egyptians spoke to the midwives of the Hebrews; the name of the one was, Sepphora; and the name of the second, Phua.

translations.lxx: And the king of the Egyptians spoke to the midwives of the Hebrews; the name of the one was, Sepphora; and the name of the second, Phua.
translations.kjv: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
translations.ron: Ba, regele Egiptului a poruncit moaşelor evreieşti, care se numeau: una Şifra şi alta Pua,
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ταῖς μαίαις τῶν Ἐβραίων, τῇ μιᾷ αὐτῶν ὄνομα Σεπφώρα, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς δευτέρας Φουά·

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎን ፡ ሶበ ፡ ታወልደሆን ፡ ለዕብራዊያት ፡ እምከመ ፡ በጽሐት ፡ ለወሊድ ፡ እመ ፡ ተባዕት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቅትላሁ ፡
                  ወእመሰ ፡ አንስት ፡ አውልዳሃ ።
verses.translation: And he said, When ye do the office of midwives to the Hebrew women, and they are about to be delivered, if it be a male, kill it; but if a female, save it.

translations.lxx: And he said, When ye do the office of midwives to the Hebrew women, and they are about to be delivered, if it be a male, kill it; but if a female, save it.
translations.kjv: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
translations.ron: Şi le-a zis: "Când moşiţi la evreice, să luaţi seama când nasc: de va fi băiat, să-l omorâţi, iar de va fi fată, să o cruţaţi!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν, ὅταν μαιοῦσθε τὰς Ἐβραίας, καὶ ὦσι πρὸς τῷ τίκτειν, ἐὰν μὲν ἄρσεν ᾖ, ἀποκτείνατε αὐτό· ἐὰν δὲ θῆλυ, περιποιεῖσθε αὐτό.

verses.geez: ወፈርሃሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዝኩ ፡ መወልዳት ፡ ወኢገብራ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወአሕየዋ ፡ ተባዕተ ።
verses.translation: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt appointed them; and they saved the male children alive.

translations.lxx: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt appointed them; and they saved the male children alive.
translations.kjv: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
translations.ron: Moaşele însă s-au temut de Dumnezeu şi n-au făcut cum le poruncise regele Egiptului, ci au lăsat şi pe băieţi să trăiască.
translations.grk: Ἐφοβήθησαν δὲ αἱ μαῖαι τὸν Θεὸν, καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησαν καθότι συνέταξεν αὐταῖς ὁ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου, καὶ ἐζωογόνουν τὰ ἄρσενα.

verses.geez: ወጸውዖን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ለመወልዳት ፡ ወይቤሎን ፡ እፎኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትገብራ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ወታ[ሐ]ይዋ ፡ ተባዕተ ።
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt called the midwives, and said to them, Why is it that ye have done this thing, and saved the male children alive?

translations.lxx: And the king of Egypt called the midwives, and said to them, Why is it that ye have done this thing, and saved the male children alive?
translations.kjv: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
translations.ron: Atunci a chemat regele Egiptului pe moaşe şi le-a zis: "pentru ce aţi făcut aşa şi aţi lăsat să trăiască şi copiii de parte bărbătească?"
translations.grk: Ἐκάλεσε δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου τὰς μαίας, καὶ εἶπεν αὐταῖς, τί ὅτι ἐποιήσατε τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο, καὶ ἐζωογονεῖτε τὰ ἄρσενα;

verses.geez:
ወይቤላሁ ፡ መወልዳት ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ አኮ ፡ ከመ ፡ አንስተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ዕብራዊያት ፤ እንበለ ፡ ትምጻእ ፡ መወልድ ፡
                  ይወልዳ ።
verses.translation: And the midwives said to Pharao, The Hebrew women are not as the women of Egypt, for they are delivered before the midwives go in to them. So they bore children.

translations.lxx: And the midwives said to Pharao, The Hebrew women are not as the women of Egypt, for they are delivered before the midwives go in to them. So they bore children.
translations.kjv: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
translations.ron: Iar moaşele au răspuns lui Faraon: "Femeile evreice nu sunt ca egiptencele, ci ele sunt voinice şi nasc până nu vin moaşele la ele".
translations.grk: Εἶπαν δὲ αἱ μαῖαι τῷ Φαραῷ, οὐχ ὡς γυναῖκες Αἰγύπτου αἱ Ἐβραῖαι· τίκτουσι γὰρ πρὶν ἢ εἰσελθεῖν πρὸς αὐτὰς τὰς μαίας· καὶ ἔτικτον.

verses.geez: ወአሠነየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለመወልዳት ፡ ወመልአ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወጸንዐ ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.translation: And God did well to the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very strong.

translations.lxx: And God did well to the midwives, and the people multiplied, and grew very strong.
translations.kjv: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
translations.ron: De aceea Dumnezeu a făcut bine moaşelor, iar poporul lui Israel se înmulţea şi se întărea mereu.
translations.grk: Εὖ δὲ ἐποίει ὁ Θεὸς ταῖς μαίαις· καὶ ἐπλήθυνεν ὁ λαὸς, καὶ ἴσχυε σφόδπα.

verses.geez: ወእስመ ፡ ፈርሃሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ መወልዳት ፡ ገብራ ፡ አብያተ ።
verses.translation: And as the midwives feared God, they established for themselves families.

translations.lxx: And as the midwives feared God, they established for themselves families.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
translations.ron: Şi fiindcă moaşele se temeau de Dumnezeu, de aceea El le-a întărit neamul.
translations.grk: Ἐπεὶ δὲ ἐφοβοῦντο αἱ μαῖαι τὸν Θεὸν, ἐποίησαν ἑαυταῖς οἰκίας.

verses.geez:
ወአዘዘ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ተባዕተ ፡ ዘይትወለድ ፡ ለዕብራይ ፡ ግርዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተከዚ
                  ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ አንስተ ፡ አሕይዉ ።
verses.translation: And Pharao charged all his people, saying, Whatever male child shall be born to the Hebrews, cast into the river; and every female, save it alive.

translations.lxx: And Pharao charged all his people, saying, Whatever male child shall be born to the Hebrews, cast into the river; and every female, save it alive.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
translations.ron: Atunci Faraon a poruncit la tot poporul său şi a zis: "Tot copilul de parte bărbătească, ce se va naşte Evreilor, să-l aruncaţi în Nil, iar fetele să le lăsaţi să trăiască toate!"
translations.grk: Συνέταξε δὲ Φαραὼ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ, λέγων, πᾶν ἄρσεν, ὃ ἐὰν τεχθῇ τοῖς Ἑβραίοις, εἰς τὸν ποταμὸν ῥίψατε, καὶ πᾶν θῆλυ, ζωογονεῖτε αὐτό.
